reason: I already ask a free chatbot for Thai recipes and swaps, and I mostly just order takeaway. I might try the 3 free dishes, but I don't see why I'd pay when I barely cook 3 Thai dishes a month anyway.
objection: Talking out loud to an app while I'm cooking feels awkward, and I can't tell how this is better than the free AI I already use.
would_change_my_mind: If a free dish actually tasted like my partner's family's cooking or the takeaway I love, clearly better than what ChatGPT gives me, I'd pay $2.99.
